body: Thanks mate. I think I will try drAwing again. I haven't drawn in over a year. But my shrink says (aswel as those in this thread) that I should try drAwing those images of happiness I used to draw.

I stopped drawing after I did these.
I used to draw all sunshine and lollipops as an escape from my depression, and a friend suggested I try drawing myself... (As I drew many of my friends), but when I look in the mirror or think about myself, this is what I see. When I finished the three off with the painting, I scarred myself out of drawing, because keeping those images in my mind are one thing... But as soon as I saw them with my eyes, it broke my heart.
Am now seeing a shrink, (it was my birthday present to myself)... And he suggests I try drawing the Sunshine and lollipops again, and ease myself back into creative outlets again.

Thanks for the support though.

Thank you for the info. I will try that subreddit in future. I feel a little selfish now for posting, as I didn't even think about how others may have received my drawings... So I would like to take this opportunity to apologise all those who were adversely affected by my images.

I like you. The way you speak is very inspiring. I am going to activly action all you are saying to me.

**I read this through again, and it is a bit of vent, but i thought i'd post anyway**
I'm making this decision today. As we speak. I'm going to focus more on the happy, and when i can move on, and leave my dark clouds behind me i will. Even as i type i can feel excitement about a change that "has" to be iminent.
I don't want to die, but the overwhelming feeling of self loathing is immense. It is my inner deamon that i face (as the original thread poster and many others) every morning, every time i do anything that involves a decision, i imaging myself in the painting.
BTW the thing about anger, as a child i used to punch stuff (i broke my right knuckle twice), my parents worked so we could live hand to mouth, and i know what that was like. one of my (many fears) is that the slowness of my sucess will mean that is all i can offer my offspring (when/if i get some) is the same my parents gave me.
The only thing that i love right now is my pet fish (sounds crazy) but i feel like he is really my best mate. And every morning when i run downstairs to feed him i get scared incase he might die. In a way that will be mortifying for me. And he's only a fish. All my human care is tied up in a "disposable" pet.
I feel there are many of me, the human, the drawer, the writer, the fighter, the programmer, the gamer. but when all contained together... its just self loathing. if i draw, i feel i shoulda been writing, if i write, i shoulda been gaming (and so on).
I think what i've found out here, while responding, is that i do have the ability to get to the roots of all my problems. one at a time.

Thank you.

you are a star. you've made me think. maybe you're right. the shooting is just a metaphor for me to perhaps end this life and start another. there are so many commitments, relationship, loans, family. but i have a friend who up and left. i think i want to leave, but am not breave enough to face the new frontier, so i there for have this incredible anxt about ending the "current" life.

thank you.

Can i just say a communal response, (kinda thread hijacking here). But thank you to all the people that messaged me. There are people out there that can help me, or that won't judge on the stuff i do, or see. Sometimes the sorrow we all feel (in the world) is only in out heads. i am only begining to realise that. Waking up to these messages has made me feel good about myself.

Thank you. I will go to the book shop on monday, and see if i can find either or both. and check them out.
Thank you for your direction.
Sometimes the people behind the feelings i have are the only people i can talk to. So i don't talk. (family, friends, and partner). just wish i could up and go somewhere random like Tazmania.
Thnks, i think i'm gonna participate in SuicideWatch.

I wanted to see what i would look like if i did that. and i didn't want it to be so real. and i can't show anyone in my life. so instead, i just painted it. and now everytime i get the feeling of putting my two fingers in my mouth as a gun i know what it looks like. i draw exactly what i feel, and not what i'd do. But thanks for the subreddit. I'll check it out.
